name: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Pradhanmantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
benefit: **Accident Insurance Coverage** - ₹2,00,000 is payable in case of accidental death. - ₹2,00,000 is payable in case of total and irreversible loss of both eyes, both hands, both feet, or loss of one eye and one limb. - ₹1,00,000 is payable in case of total and irreversible loss of one eye or one limb.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant's age should be between 18 to 70 years. 1. The applicant should be a registered transport vehicle driver or conductor in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should possess a valid commercial driving or conductor license issued in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be registered on the Samagra Portal.
